mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2.5% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tight monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both show YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply-chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with both proxies > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery, a RSAFS increase > $50B signals renewed consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns in post-shock periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high FEDFUNDS to CPIAUCSL ratio (> 1.5) indicates monetary policy is ahead of inflation, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase > 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 30% of instances with PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth > 3% YoY and UNRATE < 4%, it signals a balanced economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns in balanced economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
